deniedGlobals.fetch: fetch follows redirects, honours proxy settings and skips the security lookup. Use requestHop from @urlresolve/http-resolver.
deniedGlobals.WebSocket: WebSocket skips the security lookup. Use requestHop from @urlresolve/http-resolver.

paths.node:http: Network access goes through @urlresolve/http-resolver so every connection passes the security lookup. A package that truly needs this module gets a deliberate override in biome.json.
